say:3:1421118001:1.text: Venlo, did you rest well? We picked some harmless fuzzy mushrooms for you. Are they enough?
say:3:1421118001:1.source_cn: 芬洛先生！您休息得怎么样？我们给您摘了无毒的茸茸伞菇，...

say:4:1421118002:1.text: This... this is far too generous! I haven't even thanked you properly for saving my life...
say:4:1421118002:1.source_cn: 这、这这怎么好意思！你们救了我一命，我都没来得及感谢……

say:5:1421118003:0.text: Let me break it up and check... Yep, these are the harmless ones. By the way, they taste better with their caps open!
say:5:1421118003:0.source_cn: 啊， 我先掰开看看……没错，正是无毒的茸茸伞菇。那个、...

say:6:1421118004:0.text: Hey, are worried we can't tell poisonous mushrooms from normal ones?
say:6:1421118004:0.source_cn: 我怎么觉得你是在担心我们分不清什么东西能吃，或者摘到毒蘑菇？

say:7:1421118005:1.text: Don't worry, Venlo! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> here has a keen eye for ingredients and knows just how to prepare them to perfection!

say:7:1421118005:1.male: Don't worry, Venlo! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> here has a keen eye for ingredients and knows just how to prepare them to perfection!
say:7:1421118005:1.female: Don't worry, Venlo! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> here has a keen eye for ingredients and knows just how to prepare them to perfection!

choice_prompt:8:1421118005.text: Don't worry, Venlo! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> here has a keen eye for ingredients and knows just how to prepare them to perfection!
choice_prompt:8:1421118005.source_cn: 放心吧，芬洛先生。我们有伟大的魔法师<style=stress><player_name></style>，不仅能寻找最棒的食材，还能做出完美的处理！
choice_prompt:8:1421118005.male: Don't worry, Venlo! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> here has a keen eye for ingredients and knows just how to prepare them to perfection!
choice_prompt:8:1421118005.female: Don't worry, Venlo! Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> here has a keen eye for ingredients and knows just how to prepare them to perfection!

say:9:1421118006:1.text: No need to downplay it—you know we'd be lost without you!
say:9:1421118006:1.source_cn: 你就别谦虚啦，多亏你的帮忙！
say:9:1421118006:1.male: No need to downplay it—you know we'd be lost without you!
say:9:1421118006:1.female: No need to downplay it—you know we'd be lost without you!

say:10:1421118008:0.text: Look, we've caught some starlitfish for you as well! They're super fresh!
say:10:1421118008:0.source_cn: 另外，芬洛先生。这里还有好几条浅溪星光鱼！新鲜得很！

say:11:1421118009:1.source_cn: 这、这太了不起了！感谢各位！

say:12:1421118010:1.text: By the way, I haven't had the chance to ask you all—what exactly brought you here?
say:12:1421118010:1.source_cn: 那个……看各位忙了这么久，我都还没问，请问你们来这个地...

say:13:1421118011:1.text: Actually, I'm a minstrel, and I'm composing a poem in honor of Captain Indris...
say:13:1421118011:1.source_cn: 实际上，芬洛先生，我是吟游诗人，想要创作一首有关因度厄...

say:14:1421118012:1.text: Haha! You've come to the right person! I don't know much about his story after he left and rose to greatness.
say:14:1421118012:1.source_cn: 哈哈哈，那你们可问对人了，因度厄那家伙被选拔走之后一飞...

say:15:1421118013:1.text: But we've been friends for over a decade! I know plenty about his younger days.
say:15:1421118013:1.source_cn: 但我们可是一道摸爬滚打了十来年，他小时候的事情可有不少！

say:16:1421118014:1.text: How about we continue at my place? It's almost mealtime anyway!
say:16:1421118014:1.source_cn: 这儿不是说话的地方，各位，来我家吧，正好又快到吃饭的时候了！

say:17:1421118015:1.text: Let me prepare a meal for you using the ingredients you gathered!
say:17:1421118015:1.source_cn: 请允许我借花献佛，用你们摘的这些食物招待下你们。

say:18:1421118016:1.text: We'll talk as we eat. Feel free to ask me anything!
say:18:1421118016:1.source_cn: 到时候我们边吃边说，你们有什么问题也尽管问，好不好？

choice:8:1:2.text: They did most of the work.
choice:8:1:2.male: They did most of the work.
choice:8:1:2.female: They did most of the work.
